description: Inträffade skred, ras och övriga jordrörelser (skreddatabas) - nedladdning is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.sgi.se. SGI The Swedish Geotechnical Institute is the state's expert body on landslide, race and beach erosion issues and contributes to reducing risks in the geotechnical field in society. Coverage: Sweden. The portal shows the English title as "Landslides, race and other land movements (slides database) - download" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
